name: react-native-spritestudio
description: SpriteStudio Player for React Native: plays SpriteStudio animations (.ssab) in React Native apps on the New Architecture, drawn natively through React Native Skia.

scripts.prepack: bob build && node scripts/copy-docs.mjs && node scripts/prepack.mjs

//peerDependencies: One line per package: the oldest line the Nitro/Skia side was compiled
against, so a wider range would claim a version nobody has built.
example/ pins the version it builds and runs against, which is the same or
newer; `expo install` gives users Expo's own, which is also inside the
range. Move example/'s pins by hand, not when the registry does; that is
why Dependabot and npm-check-updates are told to leave these five alone.
The caret does the right thing on both shapes: ^0.88.0 is the 0.88 line
(a caret locks the minor below 1.0.0), ^3.6.1 and ^4.6.0 span their majors.
`expo` is the exception: optional, and only the config plugin loads it.
//devDependencies: `react-test-renderer` is pinned to the exact `react` example/ pins, not a
caret: a renderer shares React's internals and is released in lockstep with
it, so the two move together. It is deprecated in React 19 and
is still the only renderer that does not need a DOM, which is what the
`view/` tests need. Move it when react moves.
//browser: Not web support — the stub barrel, so an app that ships web as well as native can still build its web bundle (built from src/index.web.ts).
